slides.title: Who benefits, and who carries the risk?
script: Hello. I am Yifan Wu. Today I will talk about ethics in Project ATOM.
Our robot aims to move test tubes in a lab. So far, we have tested robot moves on a computer. We have also tested the gripper. The full system is not ready yet.
My main question is: who gets help, and who takes the risk?
Lab workers may spend less time moving tubes. But their jobs may change. Lab owners may get more work done. But tubes or tools may break.
People nearby may face risks too. This includes cleaners. They may get little help from the robot.
I use three rules: help people, avoid harm, and be fair. We should not add risk just to save time. We should also ask workers what they need.
script_zh: 大家好，我是 Yifan Wu。今天我介绍 ATOM 项目的伦理问题。
我们的机器人目标是在实验室里搬运试管。目前，我们在电脑仿真中测试了机器人运动，也测试了夹爪。完整系统还没有准备好。
我最关心的问题是：谁得到帮助，谁承担风险？
实验室工作人员可能少花一些时间搬试管，但他们的工作也可能改变。实验室管理方可能完成更多工作，但试管或设备也可能损坏。
附近的人也可能面临风险，包括清洁人员。他们可能没有直接从机器人那里得到多少帮助。
我采用三个原则：帮助别人、避免伤害、公平对待。我们不应仅仅为了节省时间就增加风险，也应询问工作人员的需要。

slides.title: Evidence changes the ethical design decision
script: This graph shows one test of our empty gripper. The sensor reading changed, even with no tube in it.
The sensor measures a magnetic field. It does not measure force directly. We still need to test the link between the reading and force. So this graph cannot show that the grip is safe.
Right now, the code blocks force commands. I think we should keep this limit. We need more tests before using force control.
We also need to check how the robot stops. Will the tube stay in the gripper? What if the power goes off? The screen stop is not a hardware emergency stop.
Two codes guide my view. Consult Australia, rule seven: say only what we really know. Engineers Australia, rule four point two: care for people and the environment.
Our goal is to move tubes well. But we must also think about how we do it. We must think about how it may change people's work.
I learned two things. First, test each step before the robot does more. Second, ask the people who may face risks. These are my next steps. They are not finished yet. Thank you.
script_zh: 这张图展示了我们对空夹爪的一次测试。夹爪里没有试管时，传感器读数也发生了变化。
传感器测的是磁场，不是直接测力。我们仍需测试读数与力之间的关系。因此，这张图不能证明夹持是安全的。
目前，代码阻断了力控制指令。我认为应保留这个限制。在使用力控制前，我们还需要更多测试。
我们还要检查机器人怎样停止。停下后，试管能否留在夹爪里？如果断电会怎样？屏幕里的停止功能不等于硬件急停。
两条职业守则指导我的判断。Consult Australia 第七条：我们的说法要有充分知识依据。Engineers Australia 第四点二条：关心人员与环境。这里用简短的话概括了两条守则与项目的关系。
我们的目标是把试管搬好，但还必须考虑实现方式，以及它可能怎样改变别人的工作。
我学到了两点。第一，机器人做更多任务之前，应逐步测试。第二，应询问可能承担风险的人。这些是我提出的下一步工作，还没有完成。谢谢。
